lines: It’s not a lie, alas, the song of our first meeting
Even now I still recall it
My selfish password, the habit of humming it
A fanciful day off
The immobilized, truancy‑filled everyday
In the fleeting instant I’m soaked, there is value
While you sleep, I am wide‑awake
I want to meet, to align ourselves
Stop counting the habits that never overlap
My cracks and your days
Spun into invention
Before it fades, I can tell you
Do you have time now? I guess not
The missed song of our first meeting
Even now I still recall it
My selfish password, humming it is no longer a lie
It’s not a lie, not a fleeting sparkle
An illusion is an easy expression
My selfish password, please don’t say “good‑bye”
Don’t worry, I’m whining again; deception won’t work
It depends on you; I can only voice boring expectations
The vanishing moment is certain
Is it comfortable? Does it matter?
If the ending is irresponsible
Even freshly cooked rice is like that
To me it is a luxurious event
In this vague era, to become alright
A talisman corpse
Immediately, the next
If you think you can choose yourself, there is a win
The missed, dull farewell song
Even now I still recall it
My selfish password, humming it is no longer a lie
It’s not a lie, not a fleeting sparkle
So grave it blinds, a cowardly wind
It’s warm and seems about to rot
Mass‑produced equals hostile
If you’re being considerate, I don’t need it
Sneaky practice, no problem
I won’t start
Straightforwardly, I retract my previous words
Prejudice is annoying, so it’s evil
Embodiment will shatter it
I understand, I understand
My hands are cold
Avoiding was all I could do
A void ideal is still an ideal
I won’t try to compromise
The missed song of our first meeting
Even now I still recall it
My selfish password, humming it is no longer a lie
It’s not a lie, not a fleeting sparkle
An illusion is an easy expression
My selfish password, please don’t say “good‑bye”
Don’t worry, I’m still whining; deception won’t work
If it’s not you, I can only speak of a boring future
